description: This file defines the StatsApiController class which provides an API endpoint for calculating the number of investors required based on a minimum investment. It is part of the Goteo project and extends the AbstractApiController, handling requests to compute investment statistics.

classes.name: StatsApiController
classes.description: Controller class providing API endpoints related to statistical data, specifically for calculating the number of investors required for a campaign based on a minimum investment.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the controller, sets up database replication and caching.

methods.name: investorsRequiredAction
methods.description: Handles POST or GET requests to compute and return the number of investors required to meet a minimum investment goal.
